profile.summaryJa: 列王記下18:18では、ヒゼキヤの記録官ヨアフはアサフの子と記されています。

facts.textJa: ヨアフは衣を裂いてヒゼキヤのもとへ行き、ラブシャケの言葉を伝えました。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: When they had called to the king, Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebnah the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder came out to them.
Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, came with Shebna the scribe and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him Rabshakeh’s words.
